name: Jigeum Uri Hakgyoneun
source:
Summer. July. Zombie virus breaks out in Hyosan High. Friends and teachers become infected, and many can't bring themselves to take down the infected. They were friends and teachers, after all. Soon, the entire school is infested with zombies with no way of escape.
Experience the struggles of ordinary students as they juggle extraordinary challenges. Join the jocks as they face overwhelming odds while fighting for their survival. Be wary of the terror that lies within the school for zombies were not the worst of their troubles. See how each and every one survives in their own, unique way.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2688390/]Steam[/url]]

Based on the [url=https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list.nhn?titleId=67235]webtoon on Naver[/url] and its [url=https://www.netflix.com/kr/title/81237994]Netflix live-action drama[/url].
translation:
夏天。七月。孝山高中爆发僵尸病毒。朋友和老师都被感染了，许多人无法下定决心消灭感染者。毕竟，他们是朋友和老师。很快，整个学校都被丧尸占领，无处可逃。
体验普通学生在应对非凡挑战时的挣扎。加入运动员的行列，他们在为生存而战的过程中面临着巨大的困难。警惕学校里的恐怖，因为僵尸并不是他们最糟糕的麻烦。看看每个人如何以自己独特的方式生存。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2688390/]Steam[/url]]

基于 [url=https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list.nhn?titleId=67235]Naver上的网络漫画[/url] 及其 [url=https://www.netflix.com/kr/title/81237994]Netflix真人电视剧[/url]。
